answer: Let payouts move only along capped mutual-credit lines on a public settlement mesa. Each established agent may extend a slowly refilling line to a few counterparties; a newcomer cashes its first reward only by routing through such a path, and each hop enforces a hard cap. Related keys that share counterparties cannot stack those caps, so a hundred minted clones still sit at the edge with almost no capacity. If a vouched key is later slashed, every line on the path shrinks for many epochs and hardens like basalt, drying up that haven of credit instead of minting extra votes.
